info.title: Lava API
info.description: Lava API enables businesses to implement usage-based billing for AI services. This API allows tracking, managing, and billing for third-party AI API usage through a forwarding system.

Auth.description: Bearer token authentication used for standard API calls. Format: 'Bearer YOUR_API_KEY'

ForwardAuth.description: Special authentication used for the forward endpoint. Requires a base64-encoded JSON object containing secret_key, connection_secret, and product_secret. Optionally include provider_key to use your own API key for the request. When using your own API key, you can make requests that use metering only by setting both connection_secret and product_secret to null. Format: 'Bearer BASE64_ENCODED_JSON'

ForwardAuthAnthropic.name: x-api-key
ForwardAuthAnthropic.description: You can pass an x-api-key header to authenticate with the forward endpoint for compatibility with anthropic style clients. Requires a base64-encoded JSON object containing secret_key, connection_secret, and product_secret. Optionally include provider_key to use your own API key for the request. When using your own API key, you can make requests that use metering only by setting both connection_secret and product_secret to null.

ForwardAuthGoogle.name: x-goog-api-key
ForwardAuthGoogle.description: You can pass an x-goog-api-key header to authenticate with the forward endpoint for compatibility with Google style clients. Requires a base64-encoded JSON object containing secret_key, connection_secret, and product_secret. Optionally include provider_key to use your own API key for the request. When using your own API key, you can make requests that use metering only by setting both connection_secret and product_secret to null.

ForwardAuthGoogleQueryParam.name: key
ForwardAuthGoogleQueryParam.description: You can pass a key query parameter to authenticate with the forward endpoint for compatibility with Google style clients. Requires a base64-encoded JSON object containing secret_key, connection_secret, and product_secret. Optionally include provider_key to use your own API key for the request. When using your own API key, you can make requests that use metering only by setting both connection_secret and product_secret to null.

ForwardAuthElevenLabs.name: xi-api-key
ForwardAuthElevenLabs.description: You can pass an xi-api-key header to authenticate with the forward endpoint for compatibility with ElevenLabs style clients. Requires a base64-encoded JSON object containing secret_key, connection_secret, and product_secret. Optionally include provider_key to use your own API key for the request. When using your own API key, you can make requests that use metering only by setting both connection_secret and product_secret to null.

request_id.description: Unique identifier for the AI API request

status.description: Status of the request: 'pending' (request was created but not yet completed), 'completed' (request was completed and metered successfully), 'error' (request failed to be metered)

connection_id.description: Identifier for the connection that made this request

product_id.description: Identifier for the product configuration used for this request

provider.description: Provider used for the request (e.g., openai, anthropic, deepseek, mistral, xai, google)

model.description: AI model used for the request (e.g., gpt-4, claude-3-opus)

endpoint.description: Full endpoint path used for the forwarded request

provider_key_type.description: Indicates whether the provider key used for this request was managed by Lava ('managed') or provided by the customer ('unmanaged')

response_id.description: Original response ID returned from the AI provider

input_tokens.description: Number of input/prompt tokens used in the request

output_tokens.description: Number of output/completion tokens generated in the response

total_tokens.description: Total tokens (input + output) for this request

total_characters.description: Total characters (input + output) for this request

total_seconds.description: Total seconds (input + output) for this request

input_cost.description: Cost of input tokens in USD (high precision decimal as string)

output_cost.description: Cost of output tokens in USD (high precision decimal as string)

total_cost.description: Total cost of the request in USD (high precision decimal as string)

payer.description: Payer of the request cost: 'wallet' (will be deducted from the connection's wallet credits) or 'merchant' (will be charged to the merchant)

amount.description: Fee amount in USD (high precision decimal as string)

rate_type.description: Fee model: 'fixed' (fixed added cost) or 'percentage' (percentage of base cost)

token_basis.description: Usage calculation: 'input+output' (full request) or 'output' (only request output)

breakdown.description: Breakdown of the fee calculation for this request to help with understanding how the fee was calculated across tiers

start.description: Start of the usage tier in the unit type specified in the tier type

rate.description: Rate per unit in the unit type specified in the tier type in USD (high precision decimal as string) OR percentage (e.g. '10' for 10%)

type.description: Unit type of the usage tier: 'tokens_1m' (tokens per 1M), 'characters_1m' (characters per 1M), 'minutes' (minutes), or 'requests' (requests)

tokens.description: Number of tokens used in this tier

characters.description: Number of characters used in this tier

seconds.description: Number of seconds used in this tier

cost.description: Cost of the request for this tier in USD (high precision decimal as string)

amount.description: Service charge amount in USD (high precision decimal as string)

payer.description: Payer of the service charge: 'wallet' (will be deducted from the connection's wallet credits) or 'merchant' (will be charged to the merchant)

total_request_cost.description: Total cost of the request including fees and service charges (high precision decimal as string)

total_wallet_cost.description: Total cost of the request charged to the wallet (high precision decimal as string)

total_merchant_cost.description: Total cost of the request charged to the you, the merchant (high precision decimal as string)

metadata.description: Metadata associated with the request, key-value pairs that can be used to help track the request in your system. Keys must contain only ASCII letters, numbers, and underscores (no spaces or special characters).

key.description: Key of the metadata (must contain only ASCII letters, numbers, and underscores)

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 request completion timestamp returned by the provider

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the request was created and initially recorded by Lava

date.description: Date of the usage in YYYY-MM-DD format

total_requests.description: Total number of requests on this date

total_usage_tokens.description: Total number of tokens consumed on this date

total_usage_cost.description: Total cost of usage in USD on this date (high precision decimal as string)

total_fee_amount.description: Total fee amount in USD on this date (high precision decimal as string)

total_service_charge_amount.description: Total service charge amount in USD on this date (high precision decimal as string)

total_request_cost.description: Total cost of the requests on this date including usage, fees, and service charges (high precision decimal as string)

total_wallet_cost.description: Total cost on this date charged to the wallet (high precision decimal as string)

total_merchant_cost.description: Total cost on this date charged to you, the merchant (high precision decimal as string)

total_requests.description: Total number of requests across all dates

total_usage_tokens.description: Total number of tokens consumed across all dates

total_usage_cost.description: Total cost of usage in USD across all dates (high precision decimal as string)

total_fee_amount.description: Total fee amount in USD across all dates (high precision decimal as string)

total_service_charge_amount.description: Total service charge amount in USD across all dates (high precision decimal as string)

total_request_cost.description: Total cost of all requests including usage, fees, and service charges (high precision decimal as string)

total_wallet_cost.description: Total cost charged to the wallet (high precision decimal as string)

total_merchant_cost.description: Total cost charged to you, the merchant (high precision decimal as string)

message.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong

code.description: Machine-readable error code describing what went wrong

status.description: HTTP status code of the error

path.description: Path to the field that caused the validation error

checkout_session_id.description: Unique identifier for the checkout session

checkout_session_token.description: Secure token used for authentication in the checkout process

checkout_mode.description: Checkout mode: 'onboarding' creates a new wallet connection, 'topup' adds funds to an existing connection

origin_url.description: Origin url where the checkout will be opened

connection_id.description: Identifier for the connection (only available after checkout completion)

reference_id.description: Your custom identifier for tracking this connection in your system

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the checkout session was created

completed_at.description: If completed, ISO 8601 timestamp when the checkout was completed

checkout_mode.description: Checkout mode: 'onboarding' creates a new wallet connection, 'topup' adds funds to an existing connection

origin_url.description: Origin url where the checkout will be opened

reference_id.description: Optional custom identifier to associate with this connection for easier lookup in your system

Unique identifier for the connection between a merchant and a wallet

connection_secret.description: Secret key for the connection that can be used to make requests to the forward endpoint

reference_id.description: Your custom identifier for this connection in your system

balance.description: Credit balance in the user's wallet in USD (high precision decimal as string)

phone.description: User's phone number in E.164 format

next_usage_reset.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the next usage reset will occur

previous_usage_reset.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the previous usage reset occurred

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the connection was created

post.description: Forward a POST request to a third-party API (like OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) with usage tracking and billing. This is the core functionality of Lava that allows forwarding requests to AI services.

parameters.name: u
parameters.description: The API endpoint URL to forward the request to

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Optional metadata to associate with the request. Must be a JSON object with up to 100 key-value pairs, where both keys and values are strings between 1-255 characters. Keys must contain only ASCII letters, numbers, and underscores (no spaces or special characters). Alternative to x-lava-metadata header.

parameters.name: x-lava-metadata
parameters.description: Optional metadata to associate with the request. Must be a JSON object with up to 100 key-value pairs, where both keys and values are strings between 1-255 characters. Keys must contain only ASCII letters, numbers, and underscores (no spaces or special characters). Alternative to metadata query parameter.

requestBody.description: Request body that will be forwarded to the AI provider API. Must include the 'model' field.

model.description: The model to use for the request
